state.join: Original quality/cost/preference scenarios joined by source split, K, repetition and candidate index; parse visible source strings, select named fields, render joined four-field states. No resampling or invention of numeric facts. This is a new structured benchmark, not the old single-family input unchanged.
state.features: Deterministic named-field integer-percent parser, divided by 100 for student scores; four active coordinates within existing width32 budget; no candidate encoder/map/learned extraction
state.split: Original train scenarios for training diagnostics; unseen_wording scenarios for alias/polarity; unseen_criterion scenarios for weighted composition/held-combination. Whole scenario and candidate texts disjoint.
state.teacher: Exact integer sum of coefficient times percent. Gold top sets exact; stable fact-content tie-break for a concrete winner, never candidate position.

criteria.A_alias: Four authored opposite-direction alias pairs per axis; every literal axis token absent; aliases never in training. Both signs, weight1. All axis/sign directions supported by literal training.
criteria.B_polarity: Four unseen literal question templates per axis, both signs, same fixed candidate sets; every positive/negative question pair evaluated.
criteria.C_composition: Known axis pairs, held coefficient ratio1:2, all four sign combinations; all positive-ray-equivalent directions excluded from training. Three unseen composition templates.
criteria.D_held_combination: Entire axis-pair supports (reliability, operating expense) and (purchase expense, convenience) absent from training; weights1:1,2:1,1:2, all sign combinations; three unseen composition templates. Positive rays disjoint from training.
criteria.training: All four signed single axes with magnitude1/2; pairs (0,1),(1,2),(2,3),(0,3), magnitudes1:1/2:1, all signs; six literal templates per direction. All four coordinates and signed magnitudes supported. Direct criterion-vector supervision only; no IDs/catalog/teacher weights supplied to inference.
criteria.freeze: Complete authored alias inventory and renderer/split rules in exact_state_build.py committed with this protocol before corpus construction or encoding; no posthoc wording/vector changes.

interfaces.lexical: Strong literal-axis lookup control; recognize only four schema names plus generic surface polarity/weight cues, no alias dictionary and no criterion-ID access. Return UNKNOWN if no schema axis is present; unknown counts incorrect, never artificial first-position fallback.
interfaces.final_mean: Frozen final layer normalized mean of valid tokens including special tokens, unchanged shipped pooling
interfaces.layer1_mean: Same normalized valid-token mean at first transformer layer
interfaces.layer1_span: First transformer layer normalized content-token mean over the whole semantic expression. Remove only generic task prefixes Choose the option with the / Choose using / Prefer / Aim for and terminal period. Retain operators, negation, weights, every clause and alias. No axis-name lookup, catalog access, oracle values, or labels in span selection.

encoder.lineage: Same stock CBF encoder, not trained Vey-2; reject missing/mismatched keys; explicitly FP32, frozen eval
encoder.pass: Sorted unique new criterion strings only, exactly one forward per text; save layer1/final token states, token IDs, offsets, valid/special/span masks and fixed pooled features. No candidate encoding.

fit.class: Identical bias-free 384-to-4 criterion map for all three learned interfaces, FP64 SVD ridge; four active dimensions <= prior32; no extra layers, attention, candidate parameters or neural fine-tuning
fit.objective: Mean squared error against the explicit four criterion coefficients
fit.selection: Six grouped leave-one-training-template-out folds, atomic and composition template index held out together. Select lowest mean held-template coefficient MSE, ties prefer larger ridge. Refit all training queries. No test labels, features or decisions used in fitting/selection.

metrics.accuracy: Teacher-top-set membership; UNKNOWN incorrect; equal query/scenario rows, report every stratum and K. Concrete-winner accuracy also reported.
metrics.G1: Alias top1>=0.80 and paired semantic-direction-cluster bootstrap lower bound>0 versus lexical. Report95% and simultaneous98.333333% intervals for three predeclared learned comparisons; promotion uses simultaneous interval.
metrics.G2: Polarity top1>=0.90; every held literal same-attribute opposite-question pair has strictly negative predicted direction cosine; student concrete winner changes for every teacher-changing polarity-reversal pair. Report each axis and alias reversal diagnostics too.
metrics.G3: Composition AND held-combination top1>=0.80 separately; verified training/test ray disjointness and held pair-support disjointness; no criterion-ID inference.
metrics.G4: P(student_after==teacher_after | teacher_before!=teacher_after)>=0.80. All ordered semantically different direction pairs within each test stratum and template, same candidates. Concrete content-tie-broken winners. Student_changed is NOT additionally required in this gate; also report changed-to-new and both-endpoint accuracy, per-stratum rates and tie-aware counterpart.
metrics.G5: Every test query/scenario/arm: exact score equality after reversed and seed7-shuffled candidate order, restoring scores to original order, and identical concrete content winner. No tolerance.

bootstrap.unit: Semantic criterion direction, not repeated surface strings or candidate rows

metrics.promotion: A predeclared learned interface must pass ALL G1-G5 including multiplicity-controlled G1. Passing only opens a separately preregistered CBF-4 replication; B-STEF remains blocked until replication passes. Layer1_mean is the headline interface, not a posthoc winner.

scope: Controlled four-axis alias/polarity/composition/held-support screen; no arbitrary open-world criterion, natural-domain candidate extraction, multilingual or Jev-parity claim.
